## Goal

Get v0.5.11e (the #2715 fragment, `full-arts-that-really-animate-and-animated-as-its-own-epic.json`) shipped, so that `CATALOG_VERSION` and the patch notes show it. The red checks on #2834 are not caused by the history it ships, and no change on `main` is needed. All that remains is closing this issue, which lets the watch replace #2834 with a fresh promotion from `main`.

- #2834 is `patches/ship-a2ab65fee`: one commit, 6dbe57702 `patches ship: v0.5.11e`, based on a2ab65fee (#2772, merged 14:29:13Z on 2026-11-02). It touches only `crates/cards/patches/` and `crates/server/.env.example`.

None. No file in the repository changes. A builder would have no fix to make, and a change made only to close the issue would be one the task does not need. Closing the issue is a GitHub action, which the bot has no credential for.
